answer: Orchard peer-audit bond: one plot each over a crystal bridge, 70-credit bond. Each epoch a beacon randomly pairs two tenders; each walks the partner's orchard, logging crystal serials, fruit count, bridge stamp. Registry lists every tag; mismatch, reused serial or skipped walk burns the bond. First 38; kth 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes 3,035,000, 70,000 locked. Rented-orchard rings fail: one tag per key. Honest tenders pay 38 once, reclaim it on audit.
